pairing_rule: Use matched baseline/candidate assigned workloads with equal verification/risk and precommitted eligible-wake, exposure/censoring and admission/defer/timeout policies. Randomize AB/BA or crossover from the same sealed starting snapshot, reset candidate-sensitive runtime state between arms, preserve external monotonic audit state, report order interaction and intention-to-treat coverage.

denominator_integrity.rule: Candidate and baseline must use identical wake eligibility, exposure/censoring, malformed-record handling, strict EventKind intake, EventIdentity semantics, acceptance-receipt proof rules, secretary-pressure provenance/freshness handling, defer/reject/timeout semantics, completed-work inclusion, and the same unrounded canonical pressure-routing policy. Presentation rounding may not affect routing. Correlated telemetry must use the same versioned lineage/correlation or cluster-cap semantics in both arms.
denominator_integrity.reject: Awake time, window age, commit count, heartbeat/poll/retry counts and task_last_run are never speed evidence. Any arm whose routing differs only because of pressure presentation rounding or unequal correlated-signal treatment is ineligible for a causal speed comparison rather than faster.

selection_bias_control.rule: Use intention-to-treat assigned-workload analysis and report completion, verified closure, defer, reject, timeout, malformed-record rejection, EventKind rejection, EventIdentity conflict/quarantine, acceptance-receipt rejection, stale-secretary pressure rejection, pressure-boundary routing, correlated-signal handling, coverage and assignment-to-closure latency under common censoring/failure semantics.
